bundle.shortDescription: Local-first legal work desktop: matter workspaces and document editing with nothing shared by default.
bundle.longDescription: hermes-legal is a local-first desktop for legal work. Matters, documents and the database live in a local SQLite file and ordinary folders on your own computer. The Python core runs as a sidecar process managed by this Tauri 2 shell; the Hermes plugin and the local dashboard remain fully usable without the shell.
